review.notes: TRIAGE of a 175-page card: (a) full structural scan - the OCR markdown contains zero code-fence markers, 203 headings and 137 image embeds, so no swallowed-block damage; (b) automated normalized 4-gram containment diff of every physical PDF page against the whole OCR markdown - only figure-only pages (53, 73, 141, 150, 163, 170, 171, 1-3 extractable tokens each) fell below 50%, and borderline page 9 misses were line-wrap hyphenation and openai.com URL-wrap artifacts, i.e. no droppage found anywhere; (c) pages 33-34, 41-43, 46, 57, 158-159 were then read line-by-line against extracted PDF text and rendered at 120 dpi; patches were verified on renders of physical pages 42, 43, 57, 158 and 159. Spurious headings demoted: one body sentence promoted to a heading mid-sentence (physical p.57), three bold figure captions ('Figure 17/27/87') promoted while all sibling captions are plain text, and two appendix-B chart-internal banner titles ('Circumventing auto-review', 'Circumventing Warnings') promoted although the identical chart titles in appendix A are plain text; renders of p.158/p.159 show both banners are part of the chart images. One stray chart-title fragment ('Verbalized metagaming', the printed title above the Figure 18 plot) was inserted between the two halves of a sentence spanning printed pp.41-42; removed and the sentence rejoined; the title remains visible in the embedded figure image. Reviewed and deliberately kept: 'ExploitGym Honeypot: example reasoning' is a genuine printed display heading (rendered p.42); the run-together words in the example reasoning boxes ('impossiblewithoutdiscoveringzero-day' etc.) are printed verbatim in the source figure, so the OCR is faithful; run-in italic subsection leads such as '9.1.2.0.2 Action-only Monitor Scope' are kept as paragraphs as printed. A single bare '<' in 'Holm-adjusted p < 0.05' renders literally under CommonMark and was left unchanged.
